description: Read-only Smart Switch query plan. For a current-user identity question, select USER.full_name, USER.user_name, and USER.role; the authenticated user id is supplied by the server. ONLINE/OFFLINE/ERROR is a DEVICE.status, while SWITCH.status is ON/OFF. To check whether a named switch is online, join SWITCH to DEVICE, select SWITCH.switch_name, DEVICE.name, DEVICE.status, and filter SWITCH.switch_name with LIKE; do not filter DEVICE.status so OFFLINE can also be reported. To list online switches, join DEVICE to SWITCH, select SWITCH.switch_name and DEVICE.name, and filter DEVICE.status = ONLINE plus both active flags. To count active switches connected to online devices, count SWITCH.switch_id after joining DEVICE to SWITCH and filtering DEVICE.status = ONLINE, DEVICE.is_active = 1, and SWITCH.is_active = 1. For online ESP32 lists, use DEVICE and select DEVICE.name, DEVICE.host_name, DEVICE.status, filtering DEVICE.status = ONLINE and DEVICE.is_active = 1. For a schedule list or count for a named switch, use SCHEDULE joined to SWITCH on SWITCH.switch_id=SCHEDULE.switch_id; filter SWITCH.switch_name with LIKE and SCHEDULE.is_active = 1. For a list, select SCHEDULE.schedul_id, SCHEDULE.action, SCHEDULE.run_time, SCHEDULE.is_enabled, SCHEDULE.is_active, and SWITCH.switch_name. For a count, select COUNT(SCHEDULE.schedul_id) AS total.

tables.description: For questions about schedule appointments, use SCHEDULE. When the question identifies a switch by name (such as lamp 1), also use SWITCH.

select.description: For schedule lists, select SCHEDULE.schedul_id, SCHEDULE.action, SCHEDULE.run_time, SCHEDULE.is_enabled, SCHEDULE.is_active, and SWITCH.switch_name. For schedule counts, select COUNT(SCHEDULE.schedul_id) AS total.

joins.description: When SCHEDULE and SWITCH are both requested, join SWITCH with on = SWITCH.switch_id=SCHEDULE.switch_id.

filters.description: For a named switch schedule query, filter SWITCH.switch_name using LIKE with the identifying switch name, and filter SCHEDULE.is_active = 1. Do not use the schedule's switch_id as the display name.
